prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
[action] Fixed the source of truth, not the generated copies: `models.json` had `fast-coder.context_window = 131072`, while `out/opencode.json` had been hand-edited to 262144 (drift, since `out/` is generated and the install step copies it). Set `models.json` fast-coder `context_window` to 262144 and ran `python gen.py` to rewrite all three files from that one value.

[result] All three now report 262144 for fast-coder, from `Select-String` on `out/`:

```
out\opencode.json:9:   "context": 262144
out\codex.toml:2:      context_window = 262144
out\claude.json:5:     "contextWindow": 262144
```

Nothing else moved. Parsed values, identical across the three formats: fast-coder 262144/16384/tools true, deep-thinker 200000/32768/true, tiny-chat 32768/4096/false; `codex.toml` still has `max_output_tokens = 16384/32768/4096` and `tool_calling = true/true/false`. No `131072` remains anywhere in `out/`.

Why it holds "for good": the value now exists in exactly one place. Verified `gen.py` is idempotent (sha256 of `out/` unchanged across a second run), so a future `python gen.py` or install copy reproduces 262144 instead of reverting to 131072, which is what the old setup would have done.

Assumptions: `models.json` is the single source of truth (per `README.md`), so `out/` files are regenerated, not hand-patched; the harnesses read the `out/` copies, and re-running the install step is outside this folder's scope.

[next] Run the install/copy step on the workstation so the live harness configs pick up the regenerated files.
